The bare name out of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2686, headed «Преподобная Таисия Египетская», with the rank word and the epithet left off. The longer of its two lives adds a second epithet, «Фиваидская», of the Thebaid.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 8. октобар ст. ст., „Преп. Таиса.“ — Преп. is the venerable grade this corpus puts in `types` and comes off, so the bare forename is the whole of the form; the heading gives no epithet. It is not the Russian «Таисия» this folder already stores — the Serbian book drops the и — and `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for it.

source.note: No rank is read onto her. Her line is in the day's second paragraph, which carries no icon; the day's one icon is the plain one and it stands before the first line of the day, Pelagia of 457.

attestations.note: Her name page keeps this one day and reaches two lives, which agree on the whole story and differ in what they add: the shorter gives her words to the elder before her death and his answer, the longer gives the Thebaid, her birth at the end of the third century, the year 340 and the vision of Paul the Simple. The elder Paphnutius who brought her to repentance has no folder in this corpus; the two Paphnutii it holds are a martyr of Diocletian's persecution and a confessor-bishop of the Thebaid, and neither is him.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same woman: the beauty whose own mother put her to the trade at seventeen, brought to repentance by Paphnoutios, who threw her wealth into the sea and died caring for the sick. saint.gr gives no year and no place beyond that, so no `dates` object is proposed, and it prints no hymn for her. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.10.2026 (8. октобар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Таиса.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. The heading is quoted whole, **with the closing full stop the Prologue itself prints**, which is what BRIEF-SERBIAN §4 asks for. It had to be measured off the raw cached page, because `srbody.mjs` and `sr-cand.mjs` both strip it from their printed output: every heading of this day ends `. ` in the source. **An earlier wave of this reading quoted off the stripped output and wrote into its notes that the headings carry no closing stop, which the raw page contradicts for its own days as well as for these** — the rows of that wave are outside this reader’s range and are a finding for the author, not something fixed here. THE SAME WOMAN THE OTHER THREE BOOKS KEEP, identified on the scene and not the name: Egyptian by birth, set on the road by her own shameless mother, turned by Paphnutius of Sidon, a disciple of Anthony the Great, three years enclosed on bread and water, brought out of the cell against her will before her death, and shown by a vision to Paul the Simple to have a dwelling prepared for her in paradise. One man’s intervention, one disciple’s vision and one monastery: nothing here is ambiguous. `dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE PROLOGUE AGREES WITH THE FOLDER’S DEATH YEAR WITHOUT IMPROVING IT. It ends «Упокоји се ова света душа 340. год.», a flat 340 where the folder holds `death` 340 displayed «c. 340» off the longer Russian life’s «около 340 года». **Dropping the «c.» on the strength of a second book’s flat figure would narrow a hedge the first book put there**, and the interval is the same either way, so the field is left alone and the corroboration is recorded here. Birth untouched: this entry gives her no year of birth, only «По рођењу Мисирка», Egyptian by birth. `types` UNTOUCHED at `venerable`, corroborated by Преп. WHAT IS NEW, AND IT IS A THIRD ACCOUNT OF ONE ACT. What she did with the money: the Romanian life has her carry some forty pounds of gold into the middle of the city and burn it before the people, the Greek has her throw the whole of it into the sea because the price of dishonour did not deserve to be used in almsgiving, and **this book has her give it all away to the poor** — «Раздавши све своје имање беднима». Three books, three fates for the same money, and none of them is this reader’s to choose between. Smaller: Paul the Simple’s vision is of a **dwelling**, обитењ, prepared by God, where the Romanian has a bed of glory with rich coverings, three maidens and a crown. NO NEW `related`. `anthony-the-great` and `paul-the-simple` are both already there and are the two of the entry who have folders. **Пафнутије Сидонит TAKES NO ROW AND THAT IS A REFUSAL, NOT AN OVERSIGHT**: the corpus keeps nine Paphnutii and not one of them is of Sidon or is displayed as a disciple of Anthony, and an identification off a bare forename is the failure §3 calls the worst this job has. The existing life already names him in prose without a row for the same reason. The mother takes no row and no name. No `locations`, no `office`. **THE FORM IS FREE AND IS NOT THE RUSSIAN ONE.** `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Таиса», which folds to `таиса` and **not** to the `таисия` of the «Таисия» this folder already stores — the Serbian book drops the и the Russian keeps, and the fold is over letters, so no fold is widened by it. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

birth.note: The longer of the site's two lives: «Святая Таисия родилась в Египте в конце III столетия». The shorter gives no birth at all.

death.note: The longer life: «Скончалась преподобная Таисия около 340 года». The calendar's day line prints «(IV)», the fourth century, which agrees with it; the shorter life gives no year.
